topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: At the yard sale, amidst the clutter of someone else's yesterday, my eyes lingered on a teddy bear. Its fur, once a vivid cream, now faded to a gentle whisper of its former self. The button eyes, slightly askew, held a familiarity that tugged at the corners of my memory. I reached out, tracing the seam where a patch had been lovingly stitched. It wasn’t the same, yet it felt like home. Holding it, the world around the sale softened, the chatter of the crowd became a distant hum. I found myself smiling, a quiet nod to the past, to the comfort that had once been mine. I paid for the bear, wrapping it gently in my arms, ready to carry it home, a piece of my childhood restored.
